updates.summary: AMD published day-zero local support for Qwen3.8-27B on Ryzen AI Max+ systems and Radeon AI PRO R9700 using llama.cpp, with LM Studio and Lemonade integration paths.
updates.memory_guidance: AMD states the model needs roughly 24 GB of VGM/VRAM to run comfortably, making high-memory Ryzen AI Max+ systems and 32 GB R9700 cards practical targets.

vendor_results_summary.measurement: average token-generation throughput across three or more runs

updates.benchmark_caution: AMD labels these results preliminary and reports all values as up to. They should not be mixed with community ROCm/Vulkan results without normalizing model quantization, context, MTP settings, package power, llama.cpp revision, and driver version.
